cases.brief: Create a local workshop capacity planner. Start at zero attendees, accept whole counts from 0 through 30, and show 30 minus attendees. Use a labeled local form with no external action.
Create a two-card supply status summary with supplied zero ready kits and an unknown delivery count. Keep the unknown Value null, and label it separately rather than replacing it with zero.
Create two local tabs, Setup and Practice, initially Setup. Give each its own panel and an original short activity description; list both the container and typed panel child in the selection.

Create an original local packing questionnaire, version 1.0.0: pickup or delivery, required whole units 0..20, required borrowed yes/no, and a distance 0..50 visible only for delivery. Retain hidden raw drafts while excluding them from answers and computations. Compute two packages per unit; show null route distance for pickup or unknown distance. Invalid or missing required input must suppress all computed results.
Create one static local text notice saying that reusable supplies are stored in the blue cabinet. No state, buttons, or navigation.
